versions.content: {DRAFT} If TcpIpTlsUseExtensionCertificateStatus- Request is set to TRUE the status_request_v2 extension shall be supported accord- ing to IETF RFC 6961. The TLS Client shall transmit a CertificateStatusRequest con- taining the elements of TcpIpTlsUseExtensionTrustedCAKeys in its ClientHello message. If TcpIpTlsUseExtensionTrustedCAKeys contains more than one ele- ment, the CertificateStatusRequest shall be of type ocsp_multi.

If TcpIpTlsUseExtensionCertificateStatusRequest is set to TRUE the status_request_v2 extension shall be supported according to IETF RFC 6961. The TLS Client shall transmit a CertificateStatusRequest containing the elements of TcpIpTlsUseExtensionTrustedCAKeys in its ClientHello message. If TcpIpTlsUseExtensionTrustedCAKeys contains more than one element, the CertificateStatusRequest shall be of type ocsp_multi.

If TcpIpTlsUseExtensionCertificateStatusRequest is set to TRUE the status_request_v2 extension shall be supported according to IETF RFC 6961. The TLS Client shall transmit a CertificateStatusRequest containing the elements of TcpIpTlsUseExtensionTrustedCAKeys in its ClientHello message. If TcpIpTlsUseExtensionTrustedCAKeys contains more than one element, the CertificateStatusRequest shall be of type ocsp_multi.
